text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear position and repeated defense of driverless cars","quality":"argumentative stance","description":"It states a defendable claim and keeps returning to reasons supporting that claim rather than just summarizing the topic."},{"evidence":"uses crashes, texting, drinking, and pedestrians as support","quality":"relevant evidence use","description":"It brings in specific details from the article and connects them to the argument that driverless cars would improve safety."},{"evidence":"counterargument about blame in accidents followed by response","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"It acknowledges a real concern and attempts to answer it instead of ignoring the opposing side."},{"evidence":"safety and future benefits repeated across body and conclusion","quality":"idea development","description":"It develops one central line of reasoning with some elaboration rather than moving through disconnected statements."},{"evidence":"introductory claim, body paragraphs, concluding reflection","quality":"organizational structure","description":"It has a more recognizable essay structure with an opening, supporting paragraphs, and a closing statement."}]}
